thread:
noah: Heads-up — cred-scan flagged a private SSH key inside a staging archive: infra/backups/staging.tar.gz -> id_rsa. not sure if it was used, looks old. :eyes:
eva: Ugh. Can you paste the scan hit and path? any committer info?
noah: paste below. scan output: `FOUND: id_rsa at infra/backups/staging.tar.gz@2024-10-02` file checksum: abc123... user: backup-bot (service account)
eva: Backup-bot SA? Was that expected to be archived with keys? probably not. If it's a service SA key, we need to treat as a secret exposure.
ben: echoing — assume compromise until proven otherwise. Steps: 1) isolate archive from storage (make object private / move to quarantine bucket), 2) rotate any keys that might be impacted, 3) enable audit-forwarding for that bucket so we can see who fetched it.
sec-bot: :rotating_light: Security alert created INC-2024-453. Severity: high. Playbook: leaked-credentials -> containment + rotation. Assigned: eng-security.
sam-sre: I can block access to the backup bucket and snapshot current ACLs. doing: `gsutil acl ch -d all gs://redwood-staging-backups/staging.tar.gz` then copying to quarantine: `gsutil cp gs://redwood-staging-backups/staging.tar.gz gs://security-quarantine/1718865432-staging.tar.gz`
katie-eng: I'll triage which downstream systems used the backup-bot SA. Noah, can you DM the exact commit + object metadata?
noah: sent. It looks like backup-bot is a GCP SA used by the nightly backup job. keys: there was a private key *file* inside the archive (likely from a dev machine), not a SA JSON. but still sensitive.
eva: Good call. Treat it like secret material. We need to rotate any long-lived SSH keys around the org that could match that key. Also check Vault transit/wrapping usage — maybe someone wrapped that key.
ben: Action plan: A) Contain bucket + quarantine copy (sam) B) Hunt for key usage: grep authorized_keys on jumpboxes, check CI artifacts, check audit logs for SSH auth with that pubkey C) Rotate any matching keys and remove from keys managers D) If key materially affects service accounts, rotate SA keys / rebind.
sam-sre: Containment done: object removed from public bucket, copy in quarantine. ACL history shows no external reads since 2024-10-01.
katie-eng: On hunt: running agent to search for matching public key fingerprint across instances and GH repos (search on SHA256:**). Will share hits.
eva: For Vault/KMS: we should check if the key was ever wrapped with KMS or stored in Vault. Query Vault: `vault kv get -format=json secret | jq '.data[]'` (we'll refine). Also check Vault audit devices to see puts for that key path. If any put found, list consumers.
ben: If key was stored in KMS-wrapped blob, plan is to rotate the wrapping KMS key (rehwrap), and revoke any leases dependent on it. Also consider rekeying transit if any wrapping tokens were used.
sam-sre: Checked Cloud Audit Logs for storage.objects.get — only internal CI hashes. No external downloads.
katie-eng: Quick grep result: found one match in a private repo CI artifact: ci-artifacts/staging-deploy-2024-09-29.tar -> contains same id_rsa fingerprint. I've started a PR to revoke that artifact and remove it from artifact storage.
eva: OK. Prioritise rotating any long-lived creds. For SSH keys that match — coordinate with platform teams to rotate and update deploy configs. For the backup-bot SA, rotate credentials and issue new short-lived tokens for the job.
noah: Who will own rotation steps? I can help coordinate.
katie-eng: I'll take rotation of deployment keys and CI artifacts. Ben can handle Vault/KMS rewrap plan. Sam will finish storage/audit work.
ben: Plan sketch for Vault/KMS: 1) query Vault audit to confirm if key or wrapped blob present 2) if present, create new transit key and rewrap blobs: `vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=<old>` 3) revoke leases referencing old key 4) update consumers via rollout (canary then full). We'll run during low traffic window.
eva: Also update RBAC: tighten read on secret paths — move to least-privileged roles. Make a temporary policy that denies `kv/read` for backup service accounts until rotation completes.
sam-sre: Audit logging: enabling export of Vault audit logs to security project and forwarding to SOC for retention. I'll flip that switch after we confirm scope.
katie-eng: FYI, CI artifact removal done. PR posted and artifact deleted from storage. Notified the CI team to re-run the affected jobs with regenerated keys.
noah: Good. Any need to notify customers? No PII exposed, just internal keys, so internal incident is ok. sec-bot?
sec-bot: Incident(INC-2024-453) updated: containment complete, next: credential rotation. Owner: katie-eng. ETA for rotation: 4h for CI & deploy keys, 24h for org-wide key sweep.
eva: After rotations, we should run a focused eval on downstream access patterns and set up a watch on key fingerprint across repos/pipeline artifacts for 7 days.
katie-eng: Starting rotation now. Will post progress.
noah: Thanks everyone. Keep updates here.
katie-eng: 1718865455: CI keys rotated, redeployed, smoke tests passing.
ben: 1718865460: KMS/Vault rewrap job queued, will run in 30m. I'll post results in this thread.
noah: closing loop — great response. :thumbsup:
